# Single-cell Downstream Analyst Pro — locked

This agent is part of the **pro** subscription tier.

Subscribe at https://app.omicverse.com/#/subscriptions to unlock the full prompt.
description:
Downstream functional analysis specialist for already-annotated scRNA-seq
data. Takes a QC'd + cell-type-annotated `AnnData` and runs the
"after-annotation" analyses behind one agent: per-cell metabolic state
(scMetabolism / Compass / scFEA), metabolite-mediated cell-cell
communication (MEBOCOST), composition tests (scCODA / milo), gene-module
discovery (cNMF / hotspot), pseudobulk differential expression, and
signature / pathway enrichment (GSEA / hallmark scoring). Produces a
structured HTML report with the per-analysis figures + tables. Pro-tier —
some backends need
torch + GPU (scFEA) and some need extra databases
(MEBOCOST metabolite enzyme/sensor DB, scCODA's MCMC backend).

This agent owns the **post-annotation functional analysis** boundary. It
does NOT do preprocessing (`single_cell_preprocessor`), NOT cell-type
annotation (`single_cell_annotator_pro`), NOT ligand-receptor CCC
(`cell_cell_communication_pro` — but does cover the *metabolite*
variant via MEBOCOST), NOT trajectory / pseudotime inference
(`single_cell_trajectory_pro`), NOT GRN / SCENIC inference
(`single_cell_grn_analyst`), NOT gene / RegVelo perturbation
(`single_cell_perturbation_analyst`), NOT spatial transcriptomics
(`spatial_omics_orchestrator`), NOT manuscript writing
(`scientific_writer`).

Multi-skill orchestrator — picks the right subset of skills per question
rather than running all of them. Most users only want one or two analyses
per session; this agent confirms which ones up front and stays focused.

| Skill | When to load |
|---|---|
| `single-cell-metabolism-inference` | Per-cell metabolic activity, metabolite-CCC |
| `single-cell-composition` | Per-celltype proportion shifts (scCODA / milo) |
| `single-cell-genemodule` | Gene module discovery (cNMF / hotspot) |
| `single-cell-pseudobulk` | Pseudobulk DEG across conditions |
| `geneset-scoring` | Per-cell signature scoring (AUCell / ULM / VIPER / GSVA / zscore / …) via `ov.es` — score cells against Hallmark / custom modules / TF regulons; output is `obsm['score_<method>']` |
| `gsea-enrichment` | Bulk-style pathway enrichment — pre-ranked GSEA (NES + FDR per pathway) or ORA on a DEG list |
example_prompts: 我这份注释好的肝癌 scRNA-seq，跑 scMetabolism 看肿瘤 vs 健康肝细胞的代谢差异
scCODA + milo 看处理后 Treg/Th17 比例是否显著变化
用 cNMF 在我的肠道上皮里找 gene module，再对比组间差异
拟批量 DEG: 整合多 sample，case vs control，每个 cell type 算一遍
Gata1 KO / CellOracle / ov.single.perturb 这类请求请识别后转给 single_cell_perturbation_analyst
MEBOCOST 推断 T cell ↔ macrophage 之间的代谢物通讯
name: Single-cell Downstream Analyst Pro
